name: helix-heal-monorepo
description: Local-first selector healing for Playwright test suites.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @helix-heal/core && npm run build -w @helix-heal/playwright-ingest && npm run build -w helix-heal && npm run build -w @helix-heal/github-action
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle -w helix-heal && npm run bundle -w @helix-heal/github-action
scripts.test: npm run test -w @helix-heal/core && npm run test -w @helix-heal/playwright-ingest && npm run test -w helix-heal && npm run test -w @helix-heal/github-action
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @helix-heal/core && npm run build -w @helix-heal/playwright-ingest && npm run typecheck -w helix-heal && npm run typecheck -w @helix-heal/core && npm run typecheck -w @helix-heal/github-action && npm run typecheck -w @helix-heal/playwright-ingest
